"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CalendarIcon, CloudIcon, GitBranchIcon, MessageSquareIcon, PlugIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/sheet" const initial = [ { id: "chat", name: "Relay Chat", hint: "Post alerts to channels", icon: MessageSquareIcon, connected: true, }, { id: "git", name: "Forge Git", hint: "Link commits to issues", icon: GitBranchIcon, connected: false, }, { id: "cal", name: "Daybook Calendar", hint: "Sync due dates", icon: CalendarIcon, connected: false, }, { id: "drive", name: "Cloudbox Drive", hint: "Attach files from storage", icon: CloudIcon, connected: true, }, ] export default function IntegrationsSheet() { const [apps, setApps] = React.useState(initial) return ( }> Integrations Integrations {apps.filter((a) => a.connected).length} of {apps.length} connected
{apps.map((app) => (
{app.name} {app.hint}
))}
) }
